name: muzhi-extension
description: Bilimuzhi：面向哔哩哔哩视频的字幕时间轴、会话与 AI 工作区浏览器扩展

scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs vite.config.ts vite.content.config.ts vitest.unit.config.ts vitest.component.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts playwright.config.ts "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,html,css}" src/extension-static/manifest.json "tests/{unit,component,integration,e2e,visual}/**/*.{ts,tsx}" scripts/clean-extension-build.mjs scripts/generate-extension-icons.mjs scripts/package-extension.ps1 scripts/verify-package.ps1 scripts/scan-secrets.ps1
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs vite.config.ts vite.content.config.ts vitest.unit.config.ts vitest.component.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts playwright.config.ts "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,html,css}" src/extension-static/manifest.json "tests/{unit,component,integration,e2e,visual}/**/*.{ts,tsx}" scripts/clean-extension-build.mjs scripts/generate-extension-icons.mjs scripts/package-extension.ps1 scripts/verify-package.ps1 scripts/scan-secrets.ps1
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:component && npm run test:integration
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-extension-build.mjs && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=e2e
scripts.test:visual: npm run build:qa && node scripts/check-qa-harness-isolation.mjs --expect=present && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=visual
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:i18n && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run test:e2e && npm run scan:secrets
scripts.verify:extension: npm run build && pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/verify-package.ps1 -Path dist/extension
